exposure: Discordant umbilical artery pulsatility index (UA PI) values (one UA PI at <=95th percentile and the other >95th percentile)
Both umbilical artery pulsatility indices with normal values
Both umbilical arteries displaying abnormal pulsatility index values
cohort: Singleton pregnancies with fetal growth restriction (estimated fetal weight and/or abdominal circumference below the 10th percentile for gestational age) between 2017 and 2022, who had concurrent sampling of both umbilical arteries within 14 days of birth.
finding: Discordant umbilical artery pulsatility indices were significantly and independently associated with composite adverse perinatal outcomes in growth-restricted fetuses, with an adjusted odds ratio of 1.75 (95% CI, 1.24-2.47).
gest_age: Excludes births before 22 weeks of gestation
